title: The Adventurization Pack
description: A modpack made for people who love exploring, getting the most out of their Minecraft experience, and creators all around!
body:
In this modpack, there are a variety of mods to boost your Minecraft experience to the next level. If you want to explore deeper, feel more immerged, or want to start content creation - this may be the modpack for you! With lots of different terrain, utilization and performace mods bunched inside this pack, you'll be able to plow through anything you throw at this modpack!

Please advise : All Gallery images are used with the Mellow shader pack.

FAIR WARNING: THIS MODPACK IS SUPPOSED TO MAINLY BE USED OF MID TIER TO HIGH TIER PC. MINIMUM SPECS WOULD BE I5 7TH GEN, INTEL HD 630, 16GB RAM.
